finding: Seven recorded runs, source and checked shared dependencies remained intact after the Lab integration was retired. The next reuse can test whether the retained record is sufficient.
limitations: Historical scientific results were not rerun for retirement.

method: Inspect actual source, recorded results and dependencies; uninstall the exact integration, disable normal launchers, compare preservation hashes and independently review.
open_questions: When a later task needs one of these results, can the preserved record support it without reconstruction?
